newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish govt ends work on '98 budget, cuts deficit.
newsitem.headline: Finnish govt ends work on '98 budget, cuts deficit.

text.p: The Finnish government on Friday completed work on the 1998 state budget proposal, agreeing on total spending and a deficit below earlier targets, a senior finance ministry official told Reuters.
"The budget is ready," finance ministry state secretary Raimo Sailas said.
Total spending would be 186.8 billion markka against the finance ministry's 188 billion markka target, he said.
The deficit would be 15.4 billion markka compared with a pre-budget talks target of 17-18 billion markka.
Further details were not immediately available. The government will hold a news conference at 1230/0930 GMT.
This year, total budget spending is projected at around 192 billion markka and the deficit at some 25 billion markka.
The five-party left-right-green coalition's 1998 state budget proposal will be given to parliament on September 2.
